query:
SELECT it.id       AS "id!: Uuid",
                      it.issue_id AS "issue_id!: Uuid",
                      it.tag_id   AS "tag_id!: Uuid"
               FROM issue_tags it
               JOIN issues i ON i.id = it.issue_id
               WHERE i.project_id = $1
               ORDER BY it.rowid ASC
               LIMIT $2
